newsitem.title: USA: Alumax Inc Q3 profit up on unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Alumax Inc Q3 profit up on unit sale.

text.p: Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended
NOTES: 1996 Q3 includes a pretax gain of $71.7 million ($36.7 million, or R0.81/shr, after tax) related to the sale of certain fabricated product businesses.

1996 9 mths net also includes pretax gains of $92.8 million ($55.1 million after tax) and $78.4 million ($48.6 million after tax) related to the sale of mining interests and a 23 percent interest in the Mt. Holly primary aluminum reduction plant.

1995 9 mths includes a pretax gain of $128.8 million ($81.3 million after tax) related to the sale of a 14 percent interest in the Intalco and Eastalco primary aluminum reduction plants, and a $13.4 benefit from reversal of an income tax asset valuation allowance.
Nine months net also includes $18.6 million vs $7.9 million for dividends received from investments in Mexican mining operations.
